g.text: Clk = CoreClk; the user side of DT-1, DT-3, DR-6 and DR-7 runs on UserClk. Every block takes the link reset of DC-1.
Stat_*, Ev_*, Ecc_*: status, events and EDAC events of all blocks to the MIB; word and frame sent events of DT-5 feed the credits of DT-3 and DT-4.
